title: Minecraft Server Discovery & Auction Platform
description:
This platform lets users discover Minecraft servers and buy or sell them through auctions. It brings server browsing and a real marketplace together, so owners can list their servers and interested buyers can bid on them.

It is built with a Python/Django backend and PostgreSQL, with a JavaScript frontend, and integrates Stripe to handle the real payments behind the auction transactions.
liveUrlNote: The website was up at https://minecraft-server.up.railway.app but client discontinued it sometime later
